memories.author: D06
memories.text:
function: Independent in ADLs, walks without aid, manages insurance work part‑time.
cognition: Mini‑Cog score 4/5 (recall 3 items, clock draw normal) – negative screen.
falls: No falls in past 12 months, gait steady, timed up‑and‑go 9 seconds – normal fall risk.
medicines: 6 regular (levocetirizine 5 mg OD, cetirizine 10 mg HS, telmisartan 40 mg OD, dapagliflozin 10 mg OD, furosemide 20 mg OD, sodium bicarbonate 500 mg BD) – polypharmacy, review against Beers criteria advised.
mood: Reports occasional itching‑related irritability, denies depression or anxiety.
carers: Priya, daughter.
goals: "I want to stay active at work and keep my skin rash under control."
